content.content: {"result":"{\"mimeType\": \"text/markdown\", \"text\": \"# match3d-backend - prod deploys\\nHow prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).\\n\\nMerging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.\\n\\nWhoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting \\\"prod:\\\", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.\\n\\nA prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.\\n\\nTo roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment \\\"rollback:\\\" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer \\\"prod:\\\" comment.\\n\\nConsole changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.\\n\\nFreezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.\\n\\nThe deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.\\n\", \"id\": \"f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1\", \"name\": \"match3d-backend - prod deploys\"}"}

{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.

Pls fix it according to what is stated. \\n\\n[Zombie Match 3D](https://www.figma.com/design/TvRw8na5iGd3NynbSRUGFy/Zombie-Match-3D?node-id=6951-2861)\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-536\", \"description\": \"* The 3d model is old and it needs to be updated with the new model. \\n\\nThe prelevel dialogue is the correct one.\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52845])\\n\\nThe reward icons should be changed in general \\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52844])\\n\\nuse that one for reward icons as well!\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52843])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-558\", \"description\": \"The weekly leaderboard has 2 rules\\n\\n1. is about the stars collected \\n2. the levels beaten\\n\\nthe 2nd one should use \\\"Level:\\\" instead of icon.  \\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52865])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-112\", \"description\": \"Overall tone: Make it instantly clear that the player has **Infinite Lives** and make it *feel special* \\u2014 energetic, but not chaotic.\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52480])\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52479])\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52478])\\n\\n**Animation Elements:**\\n\\n1. **Infinite Heart Symbol:**\\n   * Add a **gentle pulse glow** behind or around the infinite heart (\\u221e\\u2764\\ufe0f) icon\\n   * Can loop every \\\\~1.5 seconds\\n   * Use a soft white or cyan glow to contrast with the red heart\\n2. **Floating Hearts (optional but juicy):**\\n   * Occasionally spawn **tiny floating hearts** that drift upward from the trash can or near the main h\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 1220}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-538\", \"description\": \"'@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @Marcus When you get a chance, can you browse quickly through our library of VFX we already have and see if there is a suitable one for the following 2 things?\\n>\\n> 1. Bread/cookie (So brown crumbs)\\n> 2. Confetti/paper (Gift box)\\n>    We don't necessarily need to have color variants for these. And don't spend too much time browsing/creating them. If you find something convenient great, if not I'll go source for something better.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-506\", \"description\": \"'@Martin.Walsh said:\\n\\n> V 1736 (Android) - Two strings are overlapping in the Zombie Lane button at home screen, top right @[PERSON_NAME_0050]\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-239\", \"description\": \"[InfiniteHeartsComplete003.mp4]([URL_52581])\\n\\nWe have this two animations that play when you start to play Plague Race. You get infinite lifes then.\\n\\nSo we want to highlight that you got infinite lifes.\\n\\nFor the first plague races we should start the version with the long path (the first debug button that i put at top right in the demo scene.)\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52580])\\n\\nRemember when we press start. this popup goes away but where that infinite heart is on the start button our infinite hearts with animation starts, so we need to make sure they start from the same position.\\n\\nOnce you get to pla\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 1216}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-419\", \"description\": \"* When I claimed both daily reward and a chest together, it's not clear what I got because there is no indication of daily reward. \\n\\n  [ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6307]_1.MP4]([URL_52722])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-473\", \"description\": \"When the endless mode is over, players can still try to match items with urgency but as soon as the level is over, the ending screen is visible.\\n\\nHowever that screen has no input blocker whatsoever. So it might be skipped at once while trying to match objects. \\n\\nHere is the expected outcome:\\n\\n* When the level ends, block the input until the x2 multiplication happens. So that players won't skip it accidentally. \\n\\n[[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6336].8623973.mp4]([URL_52789])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-503\", \"description\": \"Giving lives in teams are unresponsive and it requires a tab change to reflect the actual value of lives given. \\n\\n[teams giving lives.mp4]([URL_52817])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-169\", \"description\": \"Static image\\n\\nGIF\\n\\nLink to video.\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52545])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-507\", \"description\": \"[PERSON_NAME_0022] to chat with other engineers for tech set up\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-434\", \"description\": \"'@Leonard said:\\n\\n> I can actually replicate this. If you put the app in the background while the scene is loading you can reproduce items flying around probably not a blocker but it\\u2019s there\\n\\n[[IDENTIFIER_14055]]([URL_52740])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-435\", \"description\": \"'@Leonard said:\\n\\n> I got stuck on trophy path, I clicked on the claim button too fast\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-550\", \"description\": \"It should not deduct any lives and it should be independent from lives amount totally.\\n\\n[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6355]_1.MP4]([URL_52858])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-527\", \"description\": \"* For all rewards, we will use 2 types of generic animations. \\n  * The first one is the animations Marcus made for ZM, where boosters and currencies move to their designated places  \\u2014  Flow-Animation\\n  * the second one is the animation where the rewards rise up and disappear. \\u2014 Fade-Animation\\n* We will use different reward animations depending on where the users claim their rewards.\\n  * If the rewards are shown collectively on the screen in a separate panel, then we will use the **Flow-Animation**.\\n  * If the claim area is small and we are not opening an extra panel, then we will use the **Fad\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 1652}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-500\", \"description\": \"'@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @[PERSON_NAME_0022] So for the FTUE, we want to add an additional step. This is a step that will appear right as a level start. The game will pause in the background, and there will be an overlay, looks like this:\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-530\", \"description\": \"![image.png]([URL_52837])\\n\\nSo we got nice screens to explain what are the effects the game object do\\n\\n[ObjectEfectAll001.mp4]([URL_52836])\\n\\nI will push ad do a PR with these\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52835])\\n\\nPlease note that they go in the main scene in the Canvas game object.\\n\\nGood Luck!\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-487\", \"description\": \"[[URL_52800])\\n\\n@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @[PERSON_NAME_0120] Everything is basically identical to Endless mode in every other aspect, even the refill algo that you worked so hard on perfecting!\\n>\\n> The only new thing is that items can temporarily become single click (like using a catapult, or what we made pre-alpha 6 months ago) So I feel like this entire thing should be a much quicker turnaround compare to endless mode \\ud83e\\udd1e\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-511\", \"description\": \"![image.png]([URL_52826])\\n\\nWe need this screens with a bit of animation at the title zone to show the effects you get on different objects.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-547\", \"description\": \"'@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @[PERSON_NAME_0120] More balance changes to Boss Arena:\\n>\\n> * Rapid fire can now ONLY BE ACTIVATED WHEN IT'S FULLY CHARGED AT 3 SECONDS\\n> * Gold amount divide factor increase from 40 -> 100. So damage / 100 = gold rewarded. This is also easier for players to understand\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-478\", \"description\": \"Add the generic animations Marcus made into the system.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-499\", \"description\": \"* First of all, the \\\"level\\\" part on top right UI should be the same with 3-star win amount for the weekly bots.\\n* I don't think I should see others inventories.\\n* I cannot see player's profiles as the team members.\\n* Nuke used shouldn't be more than 3-star wins at any given moment. that's probably @douglas \\n\\n[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6343].mp4]([URL_52812])\\n\\n[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6342].mp4]([URL_52811])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-524\", \"description\": \"* These animations play in the main menu. They show the tokens earned from levels traveling to their destinations. Currently, levels award coins and live-ops tokens. For future iterations, gems should also be ready to display.\\n* This animation should not be skippable, but perhaps if the player taps X times in a row, we could speed it up. Since it\\u2019s always shown, seeing it repeatedly might become annoying.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-523\", \"description\": \"* We want to add more visual flair to this scene, as it currently looks quite simple compared to our competitors. We can add animations to general elements in the scene \\u2014 for example, each element could appear one by one with sparkles, while VFX like confetti plays in the background, similar to what we did in DD.\\n* However, these animations should be skippable by tapping the screen. We might add a 1\\u20132 second input blocker at the start, but after that, when the player taps, the final state of the animations should be shown instantly.\\n* You can find the references at this link: [[URL_52829])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-525\", \"description\": \"* This is part of the icon management system in DD\\n  * Live-ops icons appear on the screen from the right and left sides.\\n  * We can also use the generic icon animations from DD\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-421\", \"description\": \"In general, reward screens are skippable but in our version, it skips the entire rewards so players wouldn't see the rewards they gained. \\n\\nInstead, it should skip the animation part and show the reward. Then another click will close the reward screen. \\n\\n[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6308]_1.MP4]([URL_52724])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-436\", \"description\": \"Some tutorial steps are hooked to the analytics and are now sending step_name_str. Please make sure all tutorial steps including booster tutorials, pre_booster, win_Streak etc. send these steps as well so we know if users are having issues passing those steps.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-383\", \"description\": \"'@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @Blake Ignore size enforcement for dynamic item replacement as long as replacement item has greater power than replaced item\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-463\", \"description\": \"[Endless_Endcard_Sfx001.mp4]([URL_52772])\\n\\nI've deactivated the Endless Mode Reard Screen script component from the prefab as it had hardcoded animation and also needs to be modified:\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52771])\\n\\nWe now have two texts for the coins converted from the zombies amount.\\n\\nWe first have the CoinsText - it's the amount that we convert from the zombies\\n\\nIf we have multiplier then we will have the second amount text\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52770])\\n\\nCoinsText_Multiplied it's the text that shows after the first one to show that e multiplied the coins.\\n\\nBecause this prefab (EndlessRewardScreen)\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 837}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-491\", \"description\": \"[rewardsWithSfx001.mp4]([URL_52806])\\n\\nAfter you play and you get rewarded at the end of a level stuff, then the stuff must go to their specific places.\\n\\nI had to modify the MainMenuScreen prefab and add Rewards and modify the currencies part at the top so i could integrate the vfx i did.\\n\\nThe boosts need to appear one by one depending on what its rewarded, now the delay it's made to suit the presentation. but this might need to be dinamic, meaning whatever booster u get, u just delay the next booster and thats it, right now if we leave it like this and u get booster 1 and then booster 4 only  \", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 1639}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-493\", \"description\": \"[endgameCard011.mp4]([URL_52810])\\n\\nIt's time for us to upgrade the End Level screen.\\n\\nI've added a bunch of animations and sfx to it but it needs some coding work. We just need to make sure when they play to be activated only the ones you won. 1, or two or 3 stars. from left to right\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52809])\\n\\nAlso because up till now i've seen that the UI camera doesnt use the post processing effec we will need post processing activated in the game scene UI camera. I havent saved the scene myself b\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 1011}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-515\", \"description\": \"1. It should not be playing the old sound file.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-444\", \"description\": \"The details of each new event is in this sheet added as a tab: [[URL_52689])\\n\\nWe need to add the following events:\\n\\n`endless_left`\\n\\nendless_left has all the standard data we track for left_level in terms of the in_game interaction\\n\\n```\\n         \\n            new EventParameter(\\\"left_reason\\\", endLevelInformation.LeftReason),\\n\\n            new EventParameter(\\\"level_completion_time\\\", endLevelInformation.LevelTime),\\n\\n            new EventParameter(\\\"stars_achieved\\\", endLevelInformation.StarAchieved),\\n\\n            new EventParameter(\\\"matches_buster\\\", endLevelInformation.BossBusterCount),\\n\\n            \", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 2612}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-537\", \"description\": \"* Endless Mode Daily Rewards [[URL_52849])\\n  * Endless mode daily milestone score\\n* Endless Mode Weekly Rewards [[URL_52848])\\n* Daily Quest Chest Rewards [[URL_52847])\\n* Weekly Quest Chest Rewards [[URL_52846])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-512\", \"description\": \"The items after collider changes are too funky. When players reach **Level 48 Menu**, the **Boss Arena Main Panel** opens automatically.\\n2. On top of it, the **Info Panel** appears to explain the feature.\\n3. When players **tap the screen**, the Info Panel closes.\\n4. Players now see the **Boss Arena Main Panel**.\\n\\nNote: If the info panel has not been implemented yet, you can access it through this [link](https://www.figma.com/design/TvRw8na5iGd3NynbSRUGFy/Zombie-Match-3D?node-id=6930-2&p=f&t=H68H0jJn9gko69Gi-0)\\n\\n!\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 651}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-256\", \"description\": \"[PERSON_NAME_0054] said\\n\\n\\\"My suggestion is that we just take some level between level 30-100, and replace the item strategically matching color, item size and maybe even attack power similarity\\\"\\n\\n@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @Leonard Algo Levels ticket\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-519\", \"description\": \"[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6349]_1.mov]([URL_52833])\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-510\", \"description\": \"There are couple of bugs about zombie lane reward implementation. \\n\\n* Timed boosts amount\\n\\nwhen time based boost is given, it shows x1 instead of time frame. \\n\\nIt doesnt let me put integers like 0.25 and 1 is used for 1 full day, 24 hours. \\n\\n![]([URL_52825])\\n\\n* After new container 5 data is implemented, the UnlockSlot reward visual is broken. The gems in below doesn't have a text or if I put one the text duplicated for both rewards. \\n\\n![]([URL_52824])\\n\\n* the reward size is not consistent, it constantly changes and it might be even bigger than its frame. \\n\\n \", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 806}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-518\", \"description\": \"After the big overhaul of card progression, many cards are not a card anymore - they are just objects. And some others are scheduled to be unlocked later in the game.\\n\\nHowever, we didn't have those systems before so existing players with cards in which would not work in the newest builds is creating problems. In the inventory section those are already removed but the deck needs an iteration to check the availability of cards. \\n\\n![IMG_4258.pn\", \"links\": [], \"descriptionTruncated\": true, \"descriptionLength\": 679}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-509\", \"description\": \"Create a container with the following information in trophy path:\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52821])\\n\\nGraphics - auto generated\\n\\nFunctionality - reward users with X copies of this item card\\n\\nSub text - manually specified by designer \\\"Free Items Unlocked\\\"\\nInfo button - required\\n\\nInfo button leads to:\\n\\n![image.png]([URL_52820])\\n\\nDesigner to specify:\\n\\nGraphic art on the effect.\\n\\nHeadline of this container \\\"Freeze\\\"\\n\\nSubtext \\\"Match freeze items to slow down zombies\\\"\\n\\nPlease provide instructions on what scriptable object or prefab to work with.\", \"links\": []}, {\"id\": \"ZOM-392\", \"description\": \"Doc here: [[URL_52698])\\n\\n@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:\\n\\n> @Blake New Algo Levels 2.0, literally a 1/3rd page design doc. content.text:
I've finished the server side of the beta sign-off: 18 tickets are in scope, 10 are on prod and 8 aren't. Two things you told Arthur earlier turned out to be wrong. I followed Arthur's rules from the beta card on the ZM ROADMAP board, plus his later comment that spreadsheet imports count as server changes.

**Register:** "ZM Beta sign-off - server side register" is in Arthur's "ZM Beta sign-off" folder. It lists the 18 tickets that were moved to Done after the Aug 25 prod cut through Sep 30 and needed a server change. Each row shows the ticket, its server change(s) and whether it's on prod (Y/N), plus a short note.

I went by the prod deploys doc. A PR counts as on prod only if it has a "prod:" comment and was approved by someone else before it went out. After the Sep 26 freeze, that approval has to be Arthur's. A rollback takes a PR off prod.

- **On prod (10):** ZOM-459, 509, 499, 531, 537, 510, 444, 487, 547, 553.
- **Not on prod (8):**
  - ZOM-336: #40 only went to dev.
  - ZOM-392: #41 went to prod on Sep 3 before it was approved, so it doesn't count.
  - ZOM-518: #43 was never approved by anyone but its author.
  - ZOM-503: #52 went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval (#42 is fine).
  - ZOM-256: the level pack was only imported to dev.
  - ZOM-550: #50 went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval. He only commented on it.
  - ZOM-435: #51 only went to dev.
  - ZOM-557: #54 was rolled back on Sep 28.

**Corrections to your earlier messages:** On Sep 22 you told Arthur the trophy path double-claim fix (#51) was out and the 100+ seeds (#41) had been on prod since the 3rd. By these rules neither is on prod, and I said so in the reply to him.

**Tickets:** Arthur's rule 5 says anything not on prod goes back to Todo, so I moved all 8 back. Each one has a comment saying which change still has to go out.

**Arthur:** I replied in your DM with the 10/8 counts and the list of tickets that aren't on prod.

**Leonard:** I shared the register with him directly with comment access, as he asked, and replied briefly to his email.

Some imports on the deploy log only went to dev, such as the economy, loadout and boss arena HP tables. No ticket links to them, so I left them out of the register.
